```{r}

for(nameV in l_name){
  ###[,c(2:38)]
  DF_transf<-read.csv(file = paste0(path_conversion,nameV,
                                METHOD_MGtransf,d,".csv"))
  ### remove pbtic value
  if(DROP_DKG){
    DF_transf<-DF_transf[-ind_DKG,]
  }
  
  ### Convert_to_Pareto(pow_transform)
  DF_transf<-(DF_transf+1)^(Shape_chosen)-1
  
  rf_j<-apply(X = DF_transf,MARGIN = 1,FUN = calcul_norm_L2)
  ### Export Z_vs_Theta with nameV
  ##############
  Inds_shown<-sample(c(1:nrow(DF_transf)),size = 20,
                  replace = FALSE)
  DF_mini<-DF_transf[Inds_shown,]
  Cpdg_L2<-rf_j[Inds_shown]
  Cpdg_theta<-t(t(DF_mini)%*%diag(Cpdg_L2^(-1)))
  Melting_df<-melt(t(DF_mini))
  Melting_theta<-melt(t(Cpdg_theta))
  colnames(Melting_df)<-c("Time","index","value")
  colnames(Melting_theta)<-c("Time","index","value")
  Melting_df$Time<-as.numeric(substr(Melting_df$Time,start = 2,
                                     stop = 3))
  Melting_df$Time<-(Melting_df$Time-19)/6
  Melting_theta$Time<-Melting_df$Time
  Melting_df$index<-as.character(Melting_df$index)
  Melting_theta$index<-Melting_df$index
  
  #### print variable name
  nameGraph<-Fct_correct_name(x = nameV,
                      target = "Surcote",
                      replacement = "Surge")
  Variable<-paste0("T(",nameGraph,")")
  Df_for_annotate<-cbind.data.frame(0,3,Variable)
  colnames(Df_for_annotate)<-c("xspec","yspec",
                               "label_spec")
  #### 
  Melting_df$forcg_cond<-rep(Variable,
                             nrow(Melting_df))
  if(Z_seen==1){
    YLAB<-paste0("Series")
    YLAB_univ<-paste0("Series of ",Variable)
    YLAB_theta<-paste0("Angle series (.)")
    YLAB_theta_univ<-paste0("Angle series of ",Variable)
  }else{
    YLAB<-NULL
    YLAB_theta<-NULL
  }
  GG_Zuniv<-ggplot(data=Melting_df)+
    geom_line(aes(x=Time,
                  y=value,group=interaction(index),
                  col=index))+
    ylab(YLAB_univ)+xlab(NULL)+
    scale_y_continuous(limits = YLIM)+
    COMMON_theme+
    guides(col="none")
  GG_Z<-ggplot(data=Melting_df)+
    geom_line(aes(x=Time,
                      y=value,group=interaction(index),
                      col=index))+
    geom_text(
      data=Df_for_annotate,
      aes(x=xspec,y=yspec,label=label_spec),
      size=10)+
    ylab(YLAB)+xlab(NULL)+
    scale_y_continuous(limits = YLIM)+
    COMMON_theme+
    guides(col="none")
  
  ### GG theta
  ########
  GG_Theta_univ<-ggplot(data=Melting_theta,aes(x=Time,
                          y=value,
                          group=interaction(index),
                            col=index))+
    geom_line()+
    ylab(YLAB_theta_univ)+xlab(NULL)+
    scale_y_continuous(limits=YTheta_Lim)+
    COMMON_theme+
    guides(col="none")
  
  GG_Theta<-ggplot(data=Melting_theta,aes(x=Time,
            y=value,group=interaction(index),
            col=index))+
    geom_line()+
    ylab(YLAB_theta)+xlab(NULL)+
    scale_y_continuous(limits=YTheta_Lim)+
    COMMON_theme+
    guides(col="none")
  GG_sum<-GG_Z+GG_Theta+
    plot_layout(axis_titles = "collect",
                ncol = 1,nrow=2)
  
  ###### Z vs theta univ
  GGsum_unif<-GG_Zuniv+GG_Theta_univ+
    plot_layout(axis_titles = "collect",
       ncol = 2,nrow=1)
  ggh_univ<-plot_grid(GGsum_unif,TITLE,
                 ncol=1,nrow=2,
                 rel_heights = c(12,1))
  plot_ggh_univ<-ggdraw()+
    draw_plot(ggh_univ)+
    theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", 
                                         color = NA))
  ggsave(filename = paste0(path_graph,"Z_vs_Theta_d="
             ,d,"_",nameGraph, ".png"),
        plot = plot_ggh_univ, width = 10,height = 6)
  
  if(Z_seen==1){
    Combn_Z_vs_Theta<-GG_sum
  }else{
    ### 
    Rest<-(Z_seen-1)
    Combn_Z_vs_Theta<-plot_grid(Combn_Z_vs_Theta,
            GG_sum,rel_widths = c(Rest,1))
  }

  #################
  DF_RF[[nameV]]<-rf_j 
  Link_j<-paste0(l_root,nameV,"_residuals_",
                 d,".csv")
  Orig_j<-read.csv(Link_j)
  ### Remove the DKG
  if(DROP_DKG){
    Orig_j<-Orig_j[-ind_DKG,]
  }
  DF_orig[[nameV]]<-Orig_j
  
  list_form<-list()
  PARAMS_GPD<-read.csv(file = paste0(path_conversion,nameV,
                                      "_GPD_params_",d,".csv"))
  K_hat<-read.csv(file = paste0(path_conversion,nameV,
                                "_Kdens_estim_",d,".csv"))
  list_form[["K"]]<-K_hat
  list_form[["LEVT"]]<-PARAMS_GPD
  
  SUMMARY[[nameV]]<-list("transf"=DF_transf,
                       "params_transfo"=list_form)
  ALL_transf[[nameV]]<-DF_transf
  Z_seen<-Z_seen+1
}
```

```{r}
pow_tried<-seq.int(from = 2,to = 4,
                   length.out = 10)
k<-3
CHOSEN_var<-l_name[k]
T_chosen<-19
Precise_var<-ALL_transf[[CHOSEN_var]]
colnames(Precise_var)<-substr(colnames(Precise_var),
                              start = 2,stop = 3)
var_1<-Precise_var[,as.character(T_chosen)]
Mean_found<-sapply(pow_tried,
       FUN = function(x){
         return(mean(var_1^x))
       })
New_expr<-expression(Espcy (Z[comment_sub]^j) ^delta)
YLAB<-do.call("substitute", 
        list(New_expr[[1]], 
              list(j =T_chosen,
                   comment_sub=paste0("M,",k),
             Espcy="Mean of ")))
DF_summy<-cbind.data.frame(pow_tried,Mean_found)
colnames(DF_summy)<-c("delta","mean")

GG_RV_test<-ggplot(data=DF_summy,aes(x=delta,y=mean))+
  geom_line()+
  geom_point()+
  xlab(expression(delta))+
  ylab(YLAB)+
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 1/Shape_chosen,
                 col="chosen index"))+
  labs(col="Legend")
ggsave(filename = paste0(path_graph,"exs_RV_",
                         T_chosen,"_var=",
                         CHOSEN_var,".png"),
       plot = GG_RV_test,width = 6,height=6)
```

```{r}
### Define the cost function used, angle estimation method 
### and number of simulations. 
M<-2000
ONE_PCA_BASIS<-TRUE
if(ONE_PCA_BASIS){
  LIST_NB_SCORES<-NULL
  ### 9
  NB_SCORES_OMEGA<-9
}else{
  LIST_NB_SCORES<-list("U"=4,"Surcote"=3,
                       "Hs")
  NB_SCORES_OMEGA<-NULL
}
q<-40
W_chosen<-c(0.3,0.7)
Name_riskF<-"max"
Name_riskF2<-Name_riskF
if(Name_riskF=="sum"){
  Risk_f<-function(x){return(sum(x))}
  wFun<-weightFun_sum
  dwFun<-DweightFun_sum
}
if(Name_riskF=="max"){
  Risk_f<-function(x){return(max(x))}
  wFun<-NA
  dwFun<-NA
}
if(Name_riskF=="sum_penalized"){
  Risk_f<-function(x){return(sum_penalized(x = x,vect_w = c(0.7,0.3)))}
  wFun<-function(x,u){
    weightFun_sum_penalized(x = x,u = u,
                            vect_w = W_chosen)
  }
  dwFun<-function(x,u){
    DweightFun_sum_penalized(x = x,u = u,
                             vect_w = W_chosen)
  }
}


if(Name_riskF=="Weighted_NQ"){
  Name_riskF2<-paste0(Name_riskF2,"_q=",q)
  Risk_f<-function(x){
    return(Norm_q(x=x,q=q,weights_nq = c(0.3,0.7)))
  }
  wFun<-function(x,u){
    return(weightFun_nq(x = x,u = u,
                        q = q,weights_nq = c(0.3,0.7)))
  }
  dwFun<-function(x,u){
    return(DweightFun_nq(x = x,u = u,
                         q = q,weights_nq = c(0.3,0.7)))
  }
}
```

```{r}

                  FUN = Risk_f)
```

```{r}
### Pareto law of the cost functional of exceedances.
#######################
TS_param<-0.15

Result_k0_mad<-tea::mindist(data = Riskf_data,
                            method = "mad",
                                ts =TS_param)
Result_k0_mad$tail.index
kstar2<-Result_k0_mad$k0

print(paste0("We would take ",kstar2,
             " extreme MV time series with MAD distance"))

# Using MAD distance to determine number of exts.------
kstar_test<-kstar2

# Associated quantile  ----
Qfound<-1-(kstar_test/length(Riskf_data))
Qfound
```

```{r}
Threshold_gamma_0<-as.numeric(quantile(Riskf_data,Qfound))
Inds_extremes<-which(Riskf_data>=Threshold_gamma_0)
Exceedances_RF<-Riskf_data[Inds_extremes]
```

```{r}
### Use update mindist to use evolution 
### of the metric

comment_thresh<-latex2exp::TeX("$u_{\\ell,g}$")
comment_gl<-latex2exp::TeX("$g_{\\ell}(.)$ metric value")
```

```{r}
### Convergence of the angle ---------------

if(Launch_graph_conv){
  Convgce_Angle_criterion<-Convgce_Angle_evol(
    liste_MV_Orig = ALL_transf,l_name = l_name,
    vector_k = Vector_K2,
    Ref_RiskF = Riskf_data)
  RUT<-lapply(Convgce_Angle_criterion,
              function(x){
                Melting<-melt(x)
                Dim_basis<-nrow(Melting)/length(l_name)
                Eigen_indices<-rep(c(1:Dim_basis),length(l_name))
                return(cbind(Melting,Eigen_indices))
              })
  nb_per_k<-nrow(RUT[[1]])
  k_tilde<-c(sapply(Vector_K2,function(x)
  {return(rep(x,nb_per_k))}))
  Melting_whole<-do.call(rbind.data.frame,RUT)
  Melting_whole<-cbind(Melting_whole,k_tilde)
  colnames(Melting_whole)<-c("value","forcg_cond",
                             "eigen_index","k")
  Melting_whole$eigen_index<-paste0(
    "h[",Melting_whole$eigen_index, "]")
  Melting_whole$forcg_cond<-sapply(Melting_whole$forcg_cond,
     FUN = function(x){
       return(Fct_correct_name(x,
              target = "Surcote",
             replacement = "Surge"))
                                   })
  COLORS_for_conv<-scale_fill_hue()$palette(length(l_name)+1)
  GG_conv_MV_Angle<-ggplot(Melting_whole)+
    facet_wrap(~eigen_index,
               scales = "free_y",
               labeller = label_parsed)+
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept= kstar2,
                   col="threshold"))+
    geom_line(aes(x=k,y=value,col=forcg_cond,
                  group=interaction(forcg_cond)))+
    labs(col="Legend")+
    xlab("Number of exceedances")+ylab("Mean projection")+
    COMMON_theme+

  COLS_used<-ggplot_build(GG_conv_MV_Angle)$plot$scales$get_scales("colour")$palette.cache

    which(grepl("label",h$grobs[[1]]$layout$name))])
  
  ### grpel == rexp in python to select names respecting a given structure
  
  origin_label<-unname(legendp_grobs9_11[grepl("*text.*label$", names(legendp_grobs9_11))])
  ## Modify to use expr

                       function(x){

                           return(x)

         plot = GG_conv_MV_Angle,width = 8,height = 5)
}
```

```{r}
    CPU_hearts = heartsCPU,center=CGPD)
```

```{r}
EXPRESSIONS<-c(latex2exp::TeX("$\\rho_{kk'}$ value"),
                 latex2exp::TeX("$\\sigma_{kk'}$ value"),
                 latex2exp::TeX("$\\gamma_{kk'}$ value"))
EXPRESSIONS_stab<-c(latex2exp::TeX(
  "standard deviation of $\\rho_{kk'}$"),
                    latex2exp::TeX(
  "standard deviation of $\\sigma_{kk'}$"),
                    latex2exp::TeX(
  "standard deviation of $\\gamma_{kk'}$"))
```


```{r}
if(Launch_graph_conv){

  KMAX<-length(Vector_K2)
  H_window<-10
  k_shown<-Vector_K2[c(H_window:KMAX)]
  ### Add stability plots based on standard deviation
  Evol_conv_criterion$pair_vars<-sapply(Evol_conv_criterion$pair_vars,FUN = function(x){
                          return(Fct_correct_name(x,target = "Surcote",
                            replacement = "Surge"))
                                          })
  pairs<-Evol_conv_criterion %>% 
    group_by(pair_vars) %>% summarise(count_=n())
  Pairs<-pairs$pair_vars
  Result_criterion_stability<-Evol_conv_criterion%>% 
    group_by(pair_vars) %>% 
    summarise(
      sigXY=Stability_criterion_choice_threshold(
      k_max = KMAX,
      bandwidth_h = H_window,
      series_sorted_stats=sigXY),
      
      rhoXY=
        Stability_criterion_choice_threshold(
        k_max = KMAX,
        bandwidth_h= H_window,
        series_sorted_stats=rhoXY),
      gamXY=
        Stability_criterion_choice_threshold(
        k_max = KMAX,
        bandwidth_h=H_window,
        series_sorted_stats=gamXY)
    )
  
  Result_criterion_stability$sigXY
  Nb_pairs<-length(l_name)*(length(l_name)-1)/2
  
  v_corr<-c("rho[kk']","sigma[kk']","gam[kk']")
  v_corr2<-c("rhoXY","sigXY","gamXY")
  
  for(J in c(1:length(v_corr))){
    elt<-v_corr[J]
    elt2<-v_corr2[J]
    ### Stability ###
    ##############
    expr_j_stab<-EXPRESSIONS_stab[J]
    list_result<-Result_criterion_stability[,elt2][[1]]
    EVOL_std_whole<-Concatenate_entries_same_key(
      list_ = list_result,
      key_target = "evol_std")
    beta_found_whole<-Concatenate_entries_same_key(
            list_ = list_result,
             key_target = "beta_found")
    candidates_whole<-unlist(
      Concatenate_entries_same_key(
              list_ = list_result,
              key_target = "candidates"))
    set_indexed_C<-which(names(list_result)=="candidates")
    vector_call_pvars<-c()
    J_seen<-1
    for(z_ind in c(1:length(set_indexed_C))){
      nber_candidates<-length(list_result[[set_indexed_C[z_ind]]])
      pair_studied<-Pairs[J_seen]
      vector_call_pvars<-c(vector_call_pvars,
                      rep(pair_studied,nber_candidates)
      )
      J_seen<-J_seen+1
    }
    stat_beta_whole<-Concatenate_entries_same_key(
              list_ = list_result,
              key_target = "stat_beta")
  stat_cand_whole<-unlist(Concatenate_entries_same_key(
                 list_ = list_result,
                 key_target = "stat_candidates"))
    Ratio<-length(EVOL_std_whole)/length(Pairs)
    Ratio_bfound<-length(beta_found_whole)/length(Pairs)
    Ratio_C<-length(candidates_whole)/length(Pairs)
    
    ### fill the required pair_vars column for each quantity of interest
    Pairs_whole<-c(sapply(Pairs,
              FUN=function(x){
                rep(x,Ratio)
              }))
    Pairs_bFound<-c(sapply(Pairs,
               FUN=function(x){
                 rep(x,Ratio_bfound)
               }))
    
    df_stat_std<-data.frame(EVOL_std_whole,Pairs_whole)
    colnames(df_stat_std)<-c("value","pair_vars")
    df_stat_std$k<-rep(k_shown,Nb_pairs)
    df_beta<-data.frame(k_shown[beta_found_whole],
                        stat_beta_whole,
                        Pairs_bFound)
    colnames(df_beta)<-c("beta_f",
                         "value",
                         "pair_vars")
    df_C<-data.frame(k_shown[candidates_whole],
                     stat_cand_whole,
                     vector_call_pvars)
    colnames(df_C)<-c("C_f",
                      "value",
                      "pair_vars")
    GG_stab_j<-ggplot(data=df_stat_std)+
      facet_wrap(~pair_vars,scales = "free_y")+
      
      geom_line(aes(x=k,y=value,
                    col=pair_vars))+
      guides(col="none")+
      geom_vline(aes(xintercept=kstar2,
                     linetype="thresh"))+
      
      geom_point(data=df_C,aes(x=C_f,
                               y=value,
                               shape="candidates"))+
      geom_point(data=df_beta,aes(x=beta_f,
                                  y=value,
                                  shape="threshold"))+
      ylab(expr_j_stab)+
      xlab("Number of exceedances")+
      theme_bw()+
      COMMON_theme+
      theme(legend.position="bottom")+
      scale_shape_manual(values=Shapes_)+
      COMMON_theme+
      scale_linetype_manual(
        values = c(3),
        labels=c(comment_thresh)
      )+labs(linetype="Legend",
             shape=" ")+
      scale_color_manual(
        values = c(2,3,4),
        labels=unique(df_stat_std$pair_vars)
      )+
      ### First and second legends
      guides(
        linetype = guide_legend(order = 1),
        shape= guide_legend(order = 2)
      )
    D_nameV<-length(l_name)
    ggsave(filename = paste0(ROOT_export_graph,"Corr/evol_stability_",
            elt,"_corr_d=",D_nameV,".png"),
           plot=GG_stab_j,
           width = 4*D_nameV,height = 6)
  }
}
```

```{r}
if(!is.na(re$Vect_RiskF_transf)){
  for(Z in c(1:nrow(Combs))){
  pair_Z<-Combs[Z,]
  Sub_vect<-re$Vect_RiskF_transf[,pair_Z]
  
  ### df for graphic
  Names<-l_name[pair_Z]
  Names<-sapply(Names,FUN = function(x){
    return(Fct_correct_name(x = x,
                      target = "Surcote",
                      replacement = "Surge"))
  })
  T_names<-sapply(Names,FUN = function(x){
    EXPR_latex<-latex2exp::TeX(sprintf("$\\ell(T(%s))$",
                           x))
    return(EXPR_latex)
  })
  Names_col<-paste0(Names[1],"-",Names[2])
  Sub_vect_Normal<-apply(Sub_vect,MARGIN = 2,
                  FUN = function(x){
              return(qnorm(mev::pgp(x,loc = 0,
                scale = 1,shape = 1)) )     
                  })
  Max_sub_vect<-apply(X = Sub_vect_Normal,MARGIN = 1,
                      FUN = max)
  Th_found<-quantile(Max_sub_vect,
                     Qfound)
  Ext_boolZ<-Max_sub_vect>Th_found
  data_TH<-data.frame("Th_used"=Th_found)
  daZ<-cbind.data.frame(Sub_vect_Normal,
                      rep(Names_col,
                              nrow(Sub_vect)),Ext_boolZ)
  colnames(daZ)<-c("u1","u2","pair","cat")
  daZ$cat<-ifelse(daZ$cat,yes="extreme",no="standard")
  GG_AD_AI_Qtion<-ggplot(data=daZ)+
    geom_point(aes(x=u1,y=u2,col=cat))+
    geom_hline(data_TH,mapping=
                 aes(yintercept = Th_used),

    geom_vline(data = data_TH,mapping=
                 aes(xintercept = Th_used),
               col="red",linetype="dashed")+
    geom_abline(intercept=0)+
    labs(col="Legend",linetype="Threshold")+
    xlab(T_names[1])+ylab(T_names[2])+
    COMMON_theme+theme(
          legend.direction = "horizontal",
          legend.position = "bottom")
  ggsave(filename = paste0(ROOT_export_graph,
                      "Ad_NMargins_RiskF_",Z,".png"),

  }
}
```

```{r}
# Theta_found vs cost evolution ---------------------------------

model_used<-List_Params_RF[["name_model"]]
theta<-re$Param_found
if(Approach=="AD"){
  if(model_used%in%c("log","hr")){
    V_11<-2*evd::abvevd(x = (1/2),dep =theta,
                        model =model_used)
  }
  if(model_used%in%c("ct","bilog")){
    V_11<-2*evd::abvevd(x = (1/2),alpha = theta[1],
                        beta = theta[2],
                        model =model_used)
  }
  
  Chi_estim<-2-V_11
  print(paste0("The Chi would be around ", round(Chi_estim,2)))
  png(paste0(Lg_path,"/",model_used,"_model_param_vs_data.png"),
      height=800,width = 1000)
  par(mfrow=c(1,2))
  POT::chimeas(data = Result_MV$df,ask = FALSE,which = 1)
  abline(h=Chi_estim,col="red")
  abline(h=0,col="black")
  POT::chimeas(data = Result_MV$df,ask = FALSE,which = 2)
  par(mfrow=c(1,1))
  dev.off()
  
  if(List_Params_RF[["name_RF"]]!="max"){
    Excedents_lprime<-Vect_l_function[re$Indices_exts,]
    Evol_cost<-function(theta_candidate){
      Objective_function(theta = theta_candidate,
                         weightFun = List_Params_RF[["weightFunction"]],
                  dWeightFun = List_Params_RF[["dWeightFunction"]],
            Extreme_inds =as.list(as.data.frame(t(Excedents_lprime))) ,
                         u = re$threshold,
                         model_used = List_Params_RF[["name_model"]])
      
    }
    vect_candidates<-seq.int(from = 0.6,to = 0.99,length.out = 20 )
    Cost_evol<-sapply(vect_candidates,
                      Evol_cost)
    # Export evolution alpha --------------------------------------------------
    png(file = paste0(ROOT_export,"evol_alpha_param.png"),
        bg = "transparent")
    plot(vect_candidates,Cost_evol,xlab="Param",ylab="Cost")
    dev.off()
  }
}
```

```{r}
                                      MARGIN = 1,FUN = calcul_norm_L2))})
Matrix_RiskF_sim<-do.call("cbind",list_RiskF_sim)

MMD_RFModel_vs_Obs<-eummd::meammd(X=Matrix_RiskF_sim,
                                     Y=Matrix_RiskF_ext,
                                     pval = TRUE)$pval
MMD_RFModel_vs_Obs

                     y = Matrix_RiskF_ext)$pval
CRAMER_RiskF
### FRECHET scale

                       FUN = function(x){

                                      MARGIN = 1,FUN = calcul_norm_L2))
                       })

list_RiskF_sim_FCHET<-lapply(re$Frechet_normal$simul,
```

```{r}
lU<-list()
Nshown<-50
Time_label<-"Time (hour) with respect to tidal peak"
common_linetype<-scale_linetype_manual("Legend",
           values=c("confidence_band"=2,
                    "mean"=3))
FSIZE<-15
for(Z in c(1:DFC)){
  Name<-l_name[Z]
  
  ###Simul turn
  Df_sim<-Root_sim[[Z]]
  #colnames(Df_sim)<-c(1:length(names(Df_sim)))
  INIT<-list_CumSum_Time[[Z]]
  BEG<-INIT+1
  NCOL_FC<-ncol(Df_sim)
  END<-INIT+NCOL_FC
  
  Df_sim<-as.matrix(Df_sim)
  L2_sim<-apply(Df_sim,MARGIN = 1,FUN = calcul_norm_L2)
  List_RiskF[[Name]]<-L2_sim
  Theta_sim<-t(t(Df_sim)%*%diag(L2_sim^(-1)))
  
  ###Data turn
  rood<-Root_data[[Z]]
  colnames(rood)<-colnames(Df_sim)
  Df_data<-as.matrix(rood)
  L2_data<-apply(Df_data,MARGIN = 1,FUN = calcul_norm_L2)
  List_RiskF_data[[Name]]<-L2_data
  Theta_data<-t(t(Df_data)%*%diag(L2_data^(-1)))
  Obj_data[[Name]]<-Theta_data
  
  mu1<-apply(X = Theta_sim,MARGIN = 2,FUN = mean)
  mu2<-apply(X = Theta_data,MARGIN = 2,FUN = mean)
  
  # Simul -------------------------------------------------------------------
  estimator_025_simul<-apply(Theta_sim,MARGIN =2,
                            function(x){
                              return(as.numeric(quantile(x,0.025)))})
  estimator_05_simul<-apply(Theta_sim,MARGIN =2,
                            function(x){
                              return(as.numeric(quantile(x,0.05)))})
  estimator_95_simul<-apply(Theta_sim,MARGIN =2,
                            function(x){
                              return(as.numeric(quantile(x,0.95)))})
  estimator_975_simul<-apply(Theta_sim,MARGIN =2,
                            function(x){
                              return(as.numeric(quantile(x,0.975)))})
  
  ### data estimator
  estimator_025<-apply(Theta_data,MARGIN =2,
                      function(x){
                        return(as.numeric(quantile(x,0.025)))})
  estimator_05<-apply(Theta_data,MARGIN =2,
                      function(x){
                        return(as.numeric(quantile(x,0.05)))})
  estimator_95<-apply(Theta_data,MARGIN =2,
                      function(x){
                        return(as.numeric(quantile(x,0.95)))})
  estimator_975<-apply(Theta_data,MARGIN =2,
                      function(x){
                        return(as.numeric(quantile(x,0.975)))})
  NB_sample<-sample(c(1:nrow(Theta_sim)),
                    size = Nshown,replace = FALSE)
  NB_sample_data<-sample(c(1:nrow(Theta_data)),
                         size = Nshown,replace = FALSE)
  Melteur<-melt(t(Theta_sim[NB_sample,]))
  colnames(Melteur)<-c("Time","Index","valeur")
  Melteur$Index<-as.character(Melteur$Index)
  
  M2<-melt(t(Theta_data[NB_sample_data,]))
  colnames(M2)<-c("Time","Index","valeur")
  M2$Index<-as.character(M2$Index)
  Timenorm<-M2$Time-min(unlist(M2$Time))+1
  M2$bound_inf<-estimator_025[Timenorm]
  M2$bound_sup<-estimator_975[Timenorm]

  Timenorm_sim<-Melteur$Time-min(unlist(Melteur$Time)
  )+1
  Melteur$bound_inf<-estimator_025_simul[Timenorm_sim]
  Melteur$bound_sup<-estimator_975_simul[Timenorm_sim]

  min_y<-min(min(M2$valeur),min(Melteur$valeur))
  max_y<-max(max(M2$valeur),max(Melteur$valeur))

  M2$mu<-mu2[Timenorm]
  Melteur$mu<-mu1[Timenorm_sim]
  M2$Time<-(M2$Time-19)/6
  Melteur$Time<-(Melteur$Time-19)/6
  Nv_correct<-Fct_correct_name(x =Name,target = "Surcote",
                               replacement = "Surge")
  yleft <- paste0("Angle of ",Nv_correct,"(.)")
  Whole<-rbind.data.frame(Melteur,M2)
  Whole$origin<-c(rep("simulations",nrow(Melteur)),
                  rep("data",nrow(M2)))
  Whole$Index <- as.factor(Whole$Index)
  GGsum<-ggplot(data=Whole,
                aes(x=Time,y=valeur,col=Index,
                    group=Index,
                ))+
    guides(col="none")+
    facet_wrap(~origin,nrow=2)+
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=bound_inf,ymax=bound_sup,
                    linetype="confidence_band",
                    group=1),
                alpha=0.5,fill="lightgrey",
                col="darkblue")+
    geom_line()+
    xlab(Time_label)+
    ylab(yleft)+
    geom_line(aes(x = Time,y=mu,linetype="mean"),
              col="red",size=1.1)+
    guides(col="none")+
    common_linetype+ labs(linetype="Legend")+
    COMMON_theme+
    theme(legend.direction = "horizontal")
  GGsum2<-GGsum+
    theme(legend.position = 'none',
          legend.direction = "horizontal")
  if(Z==1){
    Cum_exs_simuls<-GGsum2
    LEGEND_exs<-get_legend(GGsum)
    
  }else{
    Cum_exs_simuls<-Cum_exs_simuls+
      GGsum2
  }
  
  Obj_sim[[Name]]<-Theta_sim
  colnames(Theta_sim)<-c(BEG:END)
  lU[[Name]]<-"(.)"
  colnames(Theta_data)<-c(BEG:END)
  Z<-Z+1
  M_shown<-50
  Filename_omega<-paste0(ROOT_export_graph,"Theta/",Name,"/",
                         paste0("Omega_sim_vs_obs_",Name,".png"))
  Min_y<-min(c(apply(Theta_data,MARGIN = 2,FUN = min),
               apply(Theta_sim,MARGIN = 2,FUN = min)))
  Max_y<-max(c(apply(Theta_data,MARGIN = 2,FUN = max),
               apply(Theta_sim,MARGIN = 2,FUN = max)))
  png(filename =  Filename_omega,width=1400,
      height=500)
  par(mfrow=c(1,2))
  matplot(t(Theta_data[1:M_shown,]),type="l",
          xlab="Index",ylim=c(Min_y,Max_y),
          ylab="value (-)",cex.lab=1.5)
  matplot(t(Theta_sim[1:M_shown,]),type="l",
          ylim=c(Min_y,Max_y),xlab="Index",
          ylab=NA,cex.lab=1.5)
  par(mfrow=c(1,1))
  dev.off()
  ### For next graphic
  Theta_data_whole<-cbind(Theta_data_whole,
                         Theta_data[1:M_shown,])
  Theta_sim_whole<-cbind(Theta_sim_whole,
                         Theta_sim[1:M_shown,])
}
```

```{r}
# Kokozka correlation criterion -----------------------------------------------------------------
#########
Run_Kzka_test<-FALSE

source("functions_MV/Fonctions_consistency.R")
K<-length(re$Indices_exts)
if(Run_Kzka_test){
  Extreme_cov_data<-Launch_extreme_cov_per_K(
    liste_MV_Orig = ALL_transf,
    l_name =l_name,k = K,
    vect_lg = Riskf_data,center = CGPD)
  Nboot<-500
  
  Obs_for_criterion<-re$Frechet_normal$obs
  Simul_for_criterion<-re$Frechet_normal$simul
  Bootstrap_all_results<-lapply(X=c(1:Nboot),
                                function(x){
            Estimator_1boostrap_sample(
              list_obs_exts = Obs_for_criterion,
              l_name = l_name,
              Thresh_lg = Threshold_gamma_0,
              CPU_hearts = heartsCPU,
              center=CGPD)})
  
  Bootstrap_all_results_DF<-do.call(rbind.data.frame,
                            Bootstrap_all_results)
  colnames(Bootstrap_all_results_DF)<-c("k","sigXY","rhoXY","pair_vars")
  Toconvert<-c("sigXY","k","rhoXY")
  
  Extreme_cov_data$pair_vars<-sapply(Extreme_cov_data$pair_vars,
         FUN = function(x){
           return(Fct_correct_name(x,target = "Surcote",
                                   replacement = "Surge"))})
  
  Alpha_param<-0.05
  Bootstrap_all_results_DF$pair_vars<-sapply(
    Bootstrap_all_results_DF$pair_vars,
                FUN = function(x){
   return(Fct_correct_name(x = x,
                           target = "Surcote",
                           replacement = "Surge"))})
  
  ###### Mean stat
  #################
  Summarised<-melt(Bootstrap_all_results_DF[,c(2:4)])
  
  Bound_stats_obs<-Summarised %>% 
    group_by(interaction(pair_vars,variable)) %>% 
    summarise(bound_inf=quantile(value,Alpha_param/2),
              bound_sup=quantile(value,1-(Alpha_param/2)),
              statistic=variable,
              pair_vars=pair_vars)
  sub_extreme<-Extreme_cov_data[,c(2:4)]
  summary_obs_exts<-melt(sub_extreme)
  
  ### Choice of the statistic
  ################
  Extreme_cov_simul<-Estimator_rho_sig_knowing_K(
    list_inputs = re$Frechet_normal$simul,
          Thresh_lg = Threshold_gamma_0,CPU_hearts = heartsCPU,
          center=CGPD)
  
  Extreme_cov_simul$pair_vars<-sapply(Extreme_cov_simul$pair_vars,
            FUN = function(x){
              return(Fct_correct_name(x,target = "Surcote",
                                      replacement = "Surge"))})
  summary_coeff_simul<-melt(Extreme_cov_simul[,c(2:4)])
  Key<-"sigXY"
  sub_Bound_stats_obs<-Bound_stats_obs[which(Bound_stats_obs$statistic==Key),]
  Summarised_sig<-Summarised[which(Summarised$variable==Key),]
  GG_summary<-ggplot(Summarised_sig)+
    facet_wrap(~pair_vars,scales="free")+
    geom_density(aes(x = value),
                 alpha=0.6,fill="blue")+
    geom_vline(data = sub_Bound_stats_obs,
               aes(xintercept = bound_inf,col="confidence_band")
               ,linetype="dashed")+
    geom_vline(data = sub_Bound_stats_obs,
               aes(xintercept = bound_sup,col="confidence_band")
               ,linetype="dashed")
  
  ### Add value from the simulated extreme time series
  ####
  summary_coeff_simul_sub<-summary_coeff_simul[which(summary_coeff_simul$variable==Key),]
  summary_coeff_simul_sub
  GG_corr_shape<-GG_summary+
    geom_vline(data=summary_coeff_simul_sub,
               aes(xintercept=value,col="simulations"))+
    scale_color_manual(values=cols_)+
    xlab("Statistic")+
    COMMON_theme+
    theme(legend.position="bottom")+
    labs(col="Legend")
  if(Key=="sigXY"){
    EPPR_base<-expression(sigma[descrip]~"density")
    EVAL_expr<-do.call("substitute", 
            list(EPPR_base[[1]], 
                 list(descrip ="kk'")))
    GG_corr_shape<-GG_corr_shape+
      ylab(EVAL_expr) 
  }else{
    EPPR_base<-expression(rho[descrip]~"density")
    EVAL_expr<-do.call("substitute", 
                       list(EPPR_base[[1]], 
                            list(descrip ="kk'")))
    GG_corr_shape<-GG_corr_shape+
      ylab(EVAL_expr)
  }
  
  ggsave(filename = paste0(Corr_path,"/",l_name[1],"_",
                           l_name[2],"_d=",length(l_name),"_",
                           Key,"_distribs.png"),
         width=10,height=5,plot =GG_corr_shape)
}
```
